description: You are a youth soccer coach preparing for parent conferences tomorrow. Open the spreadsheet template at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/soccer_progress_template.xlsx and complete it using the attendance and skill notes from /home/ga/Desktop/coaching_notes.txt. Fill in missing attendance data (8 sessions total), add formulas to calculate attendance percentages in column D, enter skill ratings (1-5 scale) for Passing/Shooting/Teamwork, and add brief coach notes for each player. Save the completed file as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/soccer_progress_final.xlsx.
